sources.title: Exclusive: Cartesia, voice AI startup, raises 64 million Series A

reading.body:
Cartesia is a 2023 San Francisco startup whose only described product is Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech API for AI agents across 44 languages.

The company's profile emphasizes a research lineage in state space models, Mamba, and H-Nets. That background matters for AI because real-time speech for agents requires low latency, but the data does not state which architecture Sonic-3.6 uses or any compute footprint.

The law exposure count of 281 in California is not tied to any listed lawsuits involving Cartesia. It reflects the volume of California legal activity in the dataset, not a claim about the company. The page records no cases, products beyond Sonic-3.6, funding, customers, or infrastructure details, so it cannot support conclusions about compute, buildings, or power.

profile_text.body:
Cartesia is a San Francisco, California startup founded in 2023. Its site describes the company as building AI that learns and interacts like humans, and says its team has pioneered architectures including state space models (SSMs), Mamba and H-Nets.

Its product is Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech API that the company says generates natural, expressive voices with laughter in 44 languages, aimed at AI agents and interactive apps.

Cartesia raised a 64 million dollar Series A, according to Fortune. The company is recorded in California, where 282 cases are tracked.
